✨ TrafficLab-3D | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To generate a 3D digital twin visualization of traffic from everyday CCTV footage and its geographical location, making advanced traffic analysis accessible.
✨ Key Features: • Digital-twin style traffic visualization • Utilizes only MP4 CCTV footage and Google Maps location • Accessibility for students and enthusiasts • Supports custom SVG for projection mapping
📖 Summary: TrafficLab 3D is a Python-based tool that creates a digital-twin style traffic visualization from standard MP4 CCTV footage and its Google Maps location. It aims to make advanced computer vision accessible for students and enthusiasts without requiring complex camera calibration or synchronized satellite imagery.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 globalthreatmap | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Providing real-time global situational awareness and intelligence on security events, conflicts, and geopolitical developments.
✨ Key Features: • Real-Time Event Mapping • Interactive Mapbox Map • Event Feed • Intel Dossiers • Alert System
📖 Summary: Global Threat Map is a real-time situational awareness platform that visualizes security events, geopolitical developments, and threat indicators on an interactive map. It functions as an OSINT command center, providing detailed country intelligence, military base visualization, and an alert system.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 IMSI-catcher | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Educational tool for understanding GSM network operation and cellphone identification.
✨ Key Features: • Detects IMSI numbers of nearby cellphones • Displays country, brand, and operator information • Utilizes SDR receivers (RTL-SDR, HackRF, etc.) • Works with Gnu/Linux systems • Provides options for saving data to SQLite, TXT, or MySQL
📖 Summary: This Python program, IMSI-catcher, utilizes SDR receivers to detect and display IMSI numbers, along with country, brand, and operator information, of nearby cellphones. It is designed for educational purposes to understand GSM network functionality.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 afterkey | Swift
🎯 Primary Use Case: Displaying pressed keys on screen for recording, streaming, or accessibility purposes.
✨ Key Features: • Translucent key overlay with modifier support • Configurable position, colors, font size, border, opacity • System tray integration • Adjustable display duration and max visible keys
📖 Summary: AfterKey is a cross-platform utility that displays pressed keyboard keys on the screen as translucent buttons. It offers customization for appearance and behavior, with system tray integration.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 Crab-Code-IDE | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a unified, AI-powered development environment for complex software projects, enabling controlled and efficient interaction with code, tools, and AI agents.
✨ Key Features: • AI agent for codebase inspection and file modification • Integrated terminal, browser, and file explorer • Support for local projects, GitHub repositories, and SSH workspaces • MCP (Model Control Plane) and Skills integration • Desktop automation capabilities with explicit approval controls
📖 Summary: CrabCode is a cross-platform AI development environment built with Electron, React, and TypeScript. It integrates a code editor, terminal, browser, project tools, AI agent, and desktop automation into a single application for serious project work.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 ChatGPT-Product-Info | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To empower users to efficiently extract, analyze, and manage detailed product and research intelligence from their ChatGPT conversations for offline use and further analysis.
✨ Key Features: • Extracts GEO/AEO, source, citation, product, and offer intelligence from ChatGPT conversations. • Normalizes and saves research signals from active ChatGPT sessions.
📖 Summary: This Chrome extension extracts and organizes valuable intelligence from ChatGPT conversations, including product information, sources, and citations. It allows users to save, inspect, and export this data locally, enhancing research capabilities without relying on external servers.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
